scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix api && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.preparar: npm ci --prefix api --omit=dev && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run db:deploy --prefix api && npm run build:producao --prefix frontend
